summary: Both tasks are well implemented and meet all requirements from the original prompt and design document. The GrpcClient.ts changes correctly implement protocol-aware credential selection (http→insecure, https→SSL, unsupported→clear error) while preserving backward compatibility with existing v3.x http:// hosts. Worker.ts properly passes the full URL instead of discarding the scheme. Four new tests cover all credential selection paths and URI propagation. Build succeeds, all 136 tests pass (132 original + 4 new). No breaking changes to customer contracts. Code is clean with helpful comments documenting the historical context and compatibility rationale.

findings.description: The getConnectionUri and getChannelCredentials helper functions are not exported, which is fine for internal use but prevents direct unit testing of those functions in isolation. The current test approach via stubbing the module works well as an alternative.
Tests use require.cache manipulation for module stubbing which works but is somewhat fragile. This is consistent with the existing test patterns in the repo and is acceptable.
